│                         │11   tmux.lua                                                          812B │    -- Author + summary of the last commit that touched the current line, shown                         │
│                         │12   treesitter.lua                                                    1.6K │    -- greyed out past the end of the line.                                                             │
│                         │13   which-key.lua                                                     934B │    --                                                                                                  │
│                         │                                                                             │    -- Off by default. This is virtual text drawn past the end of the real line,                        │
│                         │                                                                             │    -- and it re-renders on every cursor move once `delay` elapses, so it repaints                      │
│                         │                                                                             │    -- a chunk of the screen constantly while you navigate. That is invisible on                        │
│                         │                                                                             │    -- a local terminal and genuinely disruptive over mosh from the phone, where                        │
│                         │                                                                             │    -- every one of those repaints is a frame that has to cross the network.                            │
│                         │                                                                             │    -- `<leader>gB` toggles it back on when the blame is actually wanted, and                           │
│                         │                                                                             │    -- `<leader>gb` still gives the full blame for one line on demand.                                  │
│                         │                                                                             │    current_line_blame = false,                                                                         │
│                         │                                                                             │    current_line_blame_opts = {                                                                         │
│                         │                                                                             │      delay = 500,                                                                                      │
│                         │                                                                             │      virt_text_pos = "eol",                                                                            │
│                         │                                                                             │    },                                                                                                  │
│                         │                                                                             │    on_attach = function(bufnr)                                                                         │
│                         │                                                                             │      local gs = require("gitsigns")                                                                    │
│                         │                                                                             │      local map = function(mode, lhs, rhs, desc)                                                        │
│                         │                                                                             │        vim.keymap.set(mode, lhs, rhs, { buffer = bufnr, desc = desc })                                 │
│                         │                                                                             │      end                                                                                               │
│                         │                                                                             │                                                                                                        │
│                         │                                                                             │      -- Hunk navigation. `]c`/`[c` are vim's built-in diff-mode motions, so                            │
│                         │                                                                             │      -- reusing them here keeps one habit for both cases.                                              │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "]c", function() gs.nav_hunk("next") end, "Next git hunk")                               │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "[c", function() gs.nav_hunk("prev") end, "Previous git hunk")                           │
│                         │                                                                             │                                                                                                        │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "<leader>gp", gs.preview_hunk, "Preview hunk")                                           │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "<leader>gs", gs.stage_hunk, "Stage hunk")                                               │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "<leader>gr", gs.reset_hunk, "Reset hunk")                                               │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "<leader>gS", gs.stage_buffer, "Stage buffer")                                           │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "<leader>gb", function() gs.blame_line({ full = true }) end, "Blame line (full)")        │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "<leader>gB", gs.toggle_current_line_blame, "Toggle inline blame")                       │
│                         │                                                                             │      map("n", "<leader>gd", gs.diffthis, "Diff against index")                                         │
│                         │                                                                             │    end,                                                                                                │
│                         │                                                                             │  },                                                                                                    │
│                         │                                                                             │}                                                                                                       │
│                         │                                                                             │                                                                                                        │
